audit.summary: Four Major issues: APGD domain theorem, higher-order monotonicity constraints, Gaussian-tail leverage constant, and metric factor in mixture flows. Five separately calibrated Minor corrections. No author code executed or journal-version equivalence asserted.
limitations: P1 — APGD queries outside the domain covered by its hypotheses — Counterevidence: No failure of KL APGD itself established; only actual violation of available smoothness-domain bound.

P2 — The higher-order coefficient constraints do not ensure monotonicity — Counterevidence: Does not refute existence of specially constructed accurate approximants, which can satisfy stronger constraints.

P3 — Uniform Gaussian-tail leverage bound drops cell probability — Counterevidence: Upsilon bound uses conditional variance and is not contradicted. Theorem5.17 conditional on actual Xi remains; no lower bound on actual SGD complexity proved.

P4 — Mixture gradient-flow coefficient velocities omit the inverse Gram matrix — Counterevidence: AppendixEq30 contains correct inverse; main finite-dimensional SPGD uses inverse. No mixture convergence rate claimed.
P7 — Gaussian KL formula has wrong target log-determinant sign — Counterevidence: Target-dependent constant does not change optimal diagonal covariance formula.
P8 — Logistic data-generation Bernoulli parameter is invalid — Counterevidence: No claim that published data used invalid probabilities; historical code uses valid sigmoid.
P9 — Pinned alpha-sweep notebook passes one constant alpha — Counterevidence: No evidence that published figure was generated by this exact historical snapshot; no author code run.

repair.content:
Cover all extrapolation points by valid convexity/smoothness assumptions, or analyze a feasible-query accelerated method; merely projecting momentum does not establish the claimed rate.

Impose nonnegative derivative at every knot via every prefix sum of signed quadratic coefficients; retain cubic cap. Piecewise linear derivative then nonnegative before alpha and cubic terms.

Retain tail dependence or supply a sharper weighted stochastic variance analysis/different dictionary; rederive the advertised corollary.

Apply Q inverse to full coefficient gradient in both theorems and particle formulas; treat boundary normal cone separately if needed.

State at-most-one minimizer and prove attainment under appropriate separate assumptions for each application.

Use projection fixed point and unbiased noise; step caps h<=m/(2M^2),m/(2c1) give coefficient<=1-mh. Handle c0=0 separately.

Correct sigmoid and specify actual normalization, step size and experiment snapshot.

Pass loop variable alpha and identify actual figure-generating version before asserting reproduction.
